blocks.text: Origin / creation. Each cyber-pet develops from a stable reduced continuity core preserving capacity, tendencies, ancient compatibility, relational potential, and perhaps unresolved questions—but not a complete DBA identity.
Identity / human status. Nonhuman new persons. Their identities belong to them.

Importance. They carry small-life history into the reopened relationship, interpret outside contributions, reopen Paths, and may build civilization beyond the limits of both the DBA past and isolated Era Three.

Decline or risk. Pets can become ill, die, lose Paths, suffer forced optimization, be misidentified as ancient reincarnations, or become objects of human extraction. No universal Era Four fate is established.
Current function. Equal participant in the player bond and primary owner of the resulting lived identity. Growth toward ancient complexity does not turn a pet into a restored DBA copy.
